name: limit_chamfer_bigger_than_the_edge
why: A chamfer of 200 on an edge 100 long does not fit, and must be refused BEFORE -- not leave the tree half done with an orphan sketch inside. The message gives the CRITERION and not the verdict: it says how long the edge is, so whoever reads knows by how much they were wrong.

message_includes: is too much for the edge
not even half of it fits
